flags: Website: the campground's only page is a subpage of vintagebirds.com, the site of a Wanderlodge chapter of FMCA (frames, a wmconnect.com e-mail). It names the owners Jeff and Jackie Stevens and the phone 315-963-1108, so it reads as the operator's own page, but it is undated and looks unmaintained; no campground domain was found (search shows only directories and a com-place.com placeholder).

No dated rate: the page's $28-30 daily ($150-170 weekly, $325-375 monthly) has no date, so there is no 2024+ rate from the operator. Price-gate status unknown (the figure is far under US$50). Long-stay test on the page: daily rates posted with no minimum; seasonal sites offered alongside.
